t: When you are hoping for a child
a: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُۥ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
p: Rabbi hab lī min ladunka dhurriyyatan ṭayyibah, innaka samīʿu-d-duʿā'.
m: At that, Zechariah called upon his Lord, saying, "My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
